name: Extract anatomical statistics inside tract endpoints mapped to cortical surface
summary: Computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics (vertex count, surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, curvature) inside tract-endpoint maps on the cortical surface, thresholded into labels, and outputs an endpoints CSV.
description: Thresholds each cortex-mapped endpoint map in the cortexmap func directory (values above threshold) into a surface label with Connectome Workbench, converts the labels to FreeSurfer annotations and runs mris_anatomical_stats and mri_segstats on curvature for each one. The results are merged into parc-stats/endpoints.csv. Use it after mapping tract endpoint densities to the cortical surface to get morphometry of the cortex each tract reaches. Needs a cortexmap of endpoint maps and the FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject.

inputs.description: Cortexmap whose func/ directory holds per-hemisphere tract endpoint maps (.func.gii) and whose surf/ directory holds the white surfaces.
FreeSurfer subject directory of the same subject, used for anatomical and curvature statistics.

outputs.description: endpoints.csv with one row per endpoint label: number of vertices, surface area, gray matter volume, average and SD thickness, curvature indices and curvature summary.
Intermediate thresholded maps, label files and per-label statistics text files.

parameters.description: Value above which a vertex of an endpoint map is included in that endpoint's label.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log and raw derivatives.
